title: My AI agent didn't get better. It got *lucky*.
dek: It solved a task, then failed the exact same task. Here's why.
takeaways: Run your unchanged setup twice before you trust an improvement. In my runs the gap between two identical runs was bigger than the improvement I nearly kept.
Turning the temperature to zero doesn't make runs repeatable: batching changes the maths, and clocks and file paths leak into what the model sees.
Compare the same tasks task by task and count flips. Equal totals can hide 19 fixes and 19 breaks.
Report how often an agent succeeds on every try, not just the first. Mine passed 59% of tasks on the first try and 43% on all three.
